'''Semist Bada''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] refugee who lived on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Semist Bada became a refugee during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], he was part of a group of refugees who settled on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] as part of the Republic [[Taris Resettlement Initiative|resettlement project]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="TOR" />

In [[3643 BBY]], he, along with his fellow settlers, were forced out of their settlement by Republic troops because the area was plagued by [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]]. When a Republic-allied individual volunteered to recover items from their settlement, Semist asked the hero to recover his novel from the settlement's computer. The individual succeeded, allowing Semist to finish the novel.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Semist Bada was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] (MMORPG) released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He, along with his fellow settlers, ask Republic players to recover items from their settlement in the mission "Prized Possessions".<ref name="TOR" />
